name: Dune dataset for Hargraves crater, Mars

resolution.product: CTX orthoimage used by the source study

limitations: The archive contains dune polygons and morphometric attributes, not raw mission pixels.
No acquisition timestamp is attached to individual polygons.
The dataset has no temporal series and cannot support migration or displacement analysis on its own.
Polygon attributes are source-study measurements and must not be treated as labels of a trained model.
The source archive is a 7z file; its internal shapefile must be extracted and validated before use.

published_context.citation: Emran et al., Semiautomated Identification and Characterization of Dunes at Hargraves Crater, Mars, Earth and Space Science, 2020.

notes: Verified through the Mendeley public dataset API on 2026-11-14. The archive SHA-256 matches the provider checksum. Internal shapefile inspection found 2245 polygon records with morphometric attributes.
